## Versioning impact
<!--

## Checklist
- [ ] `action.yml` is valid (if you changed one)
- [ ] Inputs are documented in the action's `README.md`
- [ ] Smoke-test workflow passes on this branch (or n/a for doc-only)
- [ ] No secrets in logs, fixtures, or commit history
